title: EconomicAuthorityError
description: Shared error shape across every surface this capability exposes: POST /sessions (400 validation, 409 SessionAuthorizationConflict), POST /sessions/recover (400 validation, 403 InvalidRecoverySecret), POST /capabilities/claim (400/401/403), and the `error` data-part an A2A operation's Task returns on TASK_STATE_FAILED/TASK_STATE_REJECTED. `detail` is not always present -- see hosted/a2a_economic_authority/sessions.py, server.py, and executor.py's `_fail`/CapabilityError handling.

error.description: Either a short human-readable message (HTTP validation errors) or an exact exception class name (e.g. "SessionAuthorizationConflict", "InvalidRecoverySecret", "MissingCredential", "InvalidCredential", "ExpiredCredential", "RevokedCredential", "InsufficientScope", "WrongDelegation", "WrongAuthorizer"). `POST /sessions/recover` deliberately returns the single value "InvalidRecoverySecret" for every failure mode (unknown payment_nonce, no recovery opt-in, or a wrong secret) so the response never discloses which case occurred.

detail.description: Optional additional context. Never contains a plaintext capability token or recovery secret.
